- [2023-05-26] Taylor Swift has won 11 Grammy Awards, 23 Billboard Music Awards, 6 iHeartRadio Music Awards, 8 Academy of Country Music Awards, and 2 Brit Awards.
- [2023-05-26] Taylor Swift has been named one of Time magazine's 100 most influential people in the world multiple times.
